subject: Choosing bedroom colours and finishes
hook: Same sample, three times of day. Watch it change.
ig:
Same sample, three times of day. Watch it change. This is why we'd rather you choose colours at home than in a showroom.

How we work when it comes to finishes:

We bring samples to your room and hold them where the wardrobe will go.
You see them in daylight, then again in the evening with lamps on, which is when most people actually use their bedroom.
We lay them next to your floor or carpet, because that's what they'll sit against.
Handles go on the sample at the same time, as antique gold and matt black change the feel of a finish completely.
Then you see your choice on the full design in 3D before anything is made.

A charcoal that looks soft at noon can feel almost black under a warm bulb. Better to find that out now.

Choosing a wardrobe finish? Comment SAMPLES and we'll send you the link to book a consultation.
fb:
Here's something that surprises people: the same wardrobe finish can look completely different depending on the time of day.

In this clip, one sample goes from bright morning light to soft afternoon light to a warm bedside lamp. That's why we like you to choose finishes in your own bedroom, next to your own flooring, with the handles held up alongside.

Then we show you the full design in 3D before anything goes to our Hanley workshop.

If you're planning fitted wardrobes, have a look at what we do.
